description: This file implements session management in PHP using the ADODB database abstraction library. It provides functions for opening, reading, writing, destroying, and garbage collecting database-backed sessions, along with example usage and configuration instructions.

methods.name: adodb_session_regenerate_id
methods.description: Regenerates the session ID, updates the database record accordingly using the ADODB connection.

methods.name: adodb_sess_open
methods.description: Initializes a persistent database connection for session management, returning true on success.

methods.name: adodb_sess_close
methods.description: Closes the database connection used for session management.

methods.name: adodb_sess_read
methods.description: Retrieves session data from the database for a given session key.

methods.name: adodb_sess_write
methods.description: Writes session data to the database, updating existing records or inserting new ones.

methods.name: adodb_sess_destroy
methods.description: Removes the session record from the database and optionally triggers expiration notifications.

methods.name: adodb_sess_gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection by removing expired sessions from the database and optimizing the session table.
